name: playwright-flaky-analyzer
description: Analyze Playwright test reports across multiple runs to detect flaky tests, track flaky-test and retry trends over time, and enforce a CI quality gate — deterministic, offline, no AI required. Generates interactive HTML dashboards, JSON, and Markdown reports.

scripts.test: node --test src/analyzer/*.test.js src/cli/*.test.js src/evidence/*.test.js src/investigation/interface.test.js src/investigation/investigate-engine.test.js src/investigation/rule-engine.test.js src/providers/*.test.js src/reporter/dashboard-json.test.js src/reporter/dashboard-json-fingerprint.test.js src/reporter/error-parser.test.js src/reporter/html.test.js src/reporter/markdown.test.js src/reporter/reporter.test.js src/utils/*.test.js
scripts.build: node -e "console.log('Build: nothing to compile (pure JS project)')"
